title: Azalea OST discs
description: Replacing disc 11 & 13 with beautiful music straight from the Azalea OST
body:
If you want some better music choices than vanilla, and want your friends questioning why you keep listning to disc 13? Then this pack is for you! Adds all the music as music discs without all the overhaul textures!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The album can be found [here!](https://windnedr.bandcamp.com/album/azalea-ost-verhaul)
